Method of Attack: Phishing attacks combining email and voice social engineering calls (hybrid vishing)
Callback phishing involving fake subscription/invoice emails followed by phishing phone calls
Tricking victims into disclosing sensitive information or installing remote desktop tools
Remote connection to victim's device to install backdoors or spread malware
Used to gain initial access to corporate networks for ransomware attacks
Indicators of Compromise: Phone numbers provided in phishing emails for callback
Use of compromised sites for phishing message distribution
Phishing emails originating from .com and .cv top-level domains
